cohort: 38,220 singleton deliveries after fresh single embryo transfers from 2007 to 2013
finding: Ovarian stimulation was associated with lower birth weight, and CC may have an adverse effect on neonatal outcomes in fresh cycles.
mod_finding: While the study doesn't directly compare modes of delivery, it found that ovarian stimulation for fresh embryo transfers, particularly using clomiphene citrate, was associated with an increased risk of preterm delivery and cesarean section.
